staticText: Quick pregnancy date-range estimator for /tools/due-date/. Its distinct purpose is calculation only: it returns a conventional estimated due date plus the 37- and 42-week calendar boundaries from a known LMP with a regular-cycle adjustment, or from a documented day-3/day-5 embryo transfer using ACOG offsets. It does not create an appointment plan; route users needing contact dates to /health/pregnancy-due-date/. Never describe the result as confirmation of pregnancy, clinical gestational age, exact conception, fetal development, labour timing, a safe waiting window, diagnosis, treatment or reassurance. Do not infer symptoms, complications or embryo age. Prefer the EDD documented by the user's maternity or fertility team. Entered dates are sensitive and must not be saved, placed in URLs, sent to analytics, uploaded, synced or required for an account. Exports are local and user initiated.
